sentence: He loved playing with him and feeding him every day.
synonym: He enjoyed playing with him and giving him food
synonymNote: enjoyed表示喜爱，giving him food等于feeding，意思相同

distractors.word: He hated playing with him and feeding him
He stopped playing with him and feeding him
distractors.note: stopped表示停止，不表达喜爱之情

distractors.word: He forgot playing with him and feeding him
distractors.note: forgot表示忘记，与原句爱的含义完全不同
